description: For finite propositional premises and a conclusion, valuations agreeing on their combined atom support either both are countervaluations or neither is.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.countervaluation_congr.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α))
  (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α)
  (v w : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (h :
    ∀
      a ∈
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.contextAtoms Γ ∪ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms A,
      v a = w a) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Countervaluation v Γ A ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Countervaluation w Γ A
